contact.address: Church St / Cunningham Rd / AECS Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka

colour_palette.details: Muted beige and yellow (#fce46c) with generic blue (#0f2ccf) accents. Does not provide visual distinction or high-end fast-casual appeal.

logo.details: Logo is loaded as an uncompressed Wix raster PNG ('Final Logo Biggies Burger White 2.png').

typography.details: Inconsistent font styles across franchise pages, franchise inquiry forms, and store locators.

contact.details: Active corporate and store-level contact lines, investor relations email, and franchise enquiry portals.

online_presence.details: Wix-based franchise template with sluggish page loads and lack of engaging product story.

verdict.commercial_rationale: High-volume grilled burger chain with outlets on Church Street and Cunningham Road. An upgraded digital experience will boost direct consumer orders and franchise conversion.

sample_website.notes: Flame and smoke aesthetic showcasing India's grilled burger legacy with interactive 3-outlet store locator.
